[{"insert":"Suitcase Russian Step Up + Bent Knee Copenhagen Raise

Two unilateral lower body movements that challenge the leg and hip from different positions. The suitcase Russian step up loads one side with the dumbbell held on the same side as the working leg, creating a lateral stability demand through the hip and glute. The bent knee Copenhagen raise that follows targets the adductor and inner thigh through an active raising pattern rather than a static hold. Push close to RPE 7-8 on both movements in each set.
"}]
